vendoring: Exact original bytes; the catalog builder evaluates only two hash-locked pure functions through AST extraction, without importing the source module or requiring ROOT/numpy.

normalization.H_factor_note: The source's literal factor 0.58 is preserved. It is not an assertion that the inclusive hadronic Higgs branching fraction is 0.58.
normalization.event_denominator: Use measured signed generator weights summed over every processed preselection event. Do not use the legacy return_signal_SF function's hardcoded generated-event counts.

existing_evidence: test/signalMCFiles/HtZt_6000_2000.txt first-line note and all seven LFNs
documented_substitute.interpolation_policy: User-authorized log-linear interpolation of positive LO production cross sections between Suu masses 6000 and 7000 GeV, followed by the source branching function evaluated at actual generated masses 6200/1950 and the HTZT mixed hadronic decay factor.
documented_substitute.limitation: This is a documented nominal interpolation, not an independently calculated 6200-GeV production cross section. No interpolation uncertainty is inferred. The entire decay cross section is not interpolated across changing chi masses.

input_inventory_scope: Dataset identifiers are reconstructed from existing local-list LFNs. Generation does not query DAS, establish current accessibility, certify complete dataset coverage, or audit full-dataset signed generator denominators.
